claims.text: The paper integrates a language model (LM) with cross-lingual word embedding to improve context-aware word translation.
Context-aware lexical choices are achieved using beam search combined with the language model, enhancing translation quality.
The language model consistently improves word-by-word translation baselines, as evidenced by performance metrics like BLEU scores.
